data.title: First Round of Nissan Tat3ees Championship Concludes in Makkah Region
data.content:
Jeddah, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The first round of the second season of the Nissan Tat3ees Championship 2026-2027 concluded yesterday in Makkah Region after two days under the supervision of the Saudi Automobile and Motorcycle Federation, with four competitors qualifying for the regional final to be held in Hail in March 2027.
    This season marks the championship’s first expansion beyond the Kingdom, welcoming participants from the UAE and Qatar and broadening opportunities to compete for the regional title.
    The second round will take place in Dammam on December 11–12, followed by stages in the UAE and Qatar, before the championship concludes in Hail.
    The second season builds on the inaugural 2025 edition, which featured three rounds in Dammam, Jeddah, and Hail, reflecting Nissan’s commitment to supporting regional talent and promoting desert motorsports.
    -- SPA
11:24 Local Time 08:24 GMT
